home.emptyText: Add your books in PDF, EPUB, TXT or CBZ. You can also drag them into this window, or find free books in Discover.

library.title: Library
library.empty: There are no books on this shelf.

reader.notFound: This book is no longer in your library.

history.title: Reading history
history.empty: No sessions yet. Open a book to start your history.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.subtitle: Create alerts to keep up your reading habit.
reminders.blocked: Notifications are blocked. You'll see the alerts inside the app.
reminders.unsupported: Notifications aren't supported here. You'll see the alerts inside the app.
reminders.enablePrompt: Turn on notifications to get alerts even when the app is in the background.
reminders.empty: You don't have any reminders yet.

explore.title: Discover
explore.subtitle: Free and legal books to add to your library. Use the search bar above to find one.
explore.noSources: You have no sources turned on.
explore.noResultsIn: No results in {{source}}. Try other words, accents (e.g. “Bécquer”) or another language.
explore.noEdition: We couldn't find a downloadable edition of this book.
explore.otherLanguage: The edition in your language wasn't available right now; an edition in “{{language}}” was added instead.

sources.title: Sources
sources.subtitle: Sources feed Discover with book catalogs. They work like Stremio add-ons: turn them on or off whenever you like.
sources.comingText: Coming soon: connect your Calibre server or other OPDS catalogs.
sources.folderText: Pick a folder (e.g. “My books”) and every PDF, EPUB, TXT and CBZ in it will be imported, subfolders included. Books you already have aren't duplicated, so you can use it again to add only the new ones.

gutenberg.description: Public-domain classics: Cervantes, Austen, Dostoevsky, Poe… Free and legal.

openlibrary.description: Internet Archive's catalog. Scanned editions of public-domain books, in EPUB or PDF.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHelp: Also sets the default language for books in Discover.
settings.aboutText: {{name}} is a free, open reading app for PC, Android and Steam.
settings.creditsText: Design inspired by Stremio. Free books from Project Gutenberg and Open Library. Icons by Lucide.
settings.licenseText: {{name}} is free software licensed under the GPL-3.0: you can use, study, modify and share it.
settings.donateText: {{name}} is free and open source. If you like it, you can help keep it going.

errors.network: Couldn't reach the source. Check your internet connection.
errors.gutenbergSlow: Gutenberg isn't responding right now (its server is slow). Try again in a while.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.hint: Press ? on any screen to see this list.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.bannerText: Share anonymous usage statistics (which sections you use, which formats you read). We never send your books, titles or searches.
privacy.settingText: Helps us know which features are used. It never includes your books, titles or searches.
privacy.adsNote: The Android version shows ads on Home and Discover (never while you read).
